purpose: Preserve the strict 0.40 scientific lane while separately testing a practical lane intended to produce several candidate races per day without forcing negative-value purchases.

owner_goal_binding.target_candidate_frequency: approximately 3 to 5 candidate races per day
owner_goal_binding.reason: Price/value veto remains allowed; candidate frequency is a research target, not permission to buy a poor-value race.

challenger_policies_to_compare.name: PRACTICAL_CONFIDENCE_35
challenger_policies_to_compare.selection: same top1 in baseline and challenger, conservative top1 probability >= 0.35

challenger_policies_to_compare.name: PRACTICAL_CONFIDENCE_30
challenger_policies_to_compare.selection: same top1 in baseline and challenger, conservative top1 probability >= 0.30

challenger_policies_to_compare.name: DAILY_TOP3
challenger_policies_to_compare.selection: among clean complete racecards for the day, rank by conservative top1 probability and retain top 3 after model freeze

challenger_policies_to_compare.name: DAILY_TOP5
challenger_policies_to_compare.selection: among clean complete racecards for the day, rank by conservative top1 probability and retain top 5 after model freeze

ticket_rule.ticket: highest-ranked top3 cars under the frozen model, fixed before any target odds lookup

price_rule.purpose: Do not achieve daily frequency by blindly buying races with insufficient model-implied value.

comparison_metrics: average price-qualified manual candidates per day
promotion_rule: No practical challenger becomes the main winning path from frequency alone. It must show acceptable frequency and later reproducible economic evidence without dependence on one or a few extreme payouts.
